Function Scalar(v As Variant) As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
If IsNull(v) Then
Scalar="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
Scalar="Empty(0)"
ElseIf IsError(v) Then
Scalar="CVErr(10)"
ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
s="Array(" & VarType(v) & ")[" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & "]"
For n=LBound(v) To UBound(v)
If n-LBound(v)>7 Then Exit For
s=s & "," & Scalar(v(n))
Next
Scalar=s
Else
Scalar=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
End Function
Function ReadP(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
ReadP=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PutP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
PutP="ok:" & ReadP(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
PutP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Action(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod)
Action=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
Action="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ParentType(o As Object) As String
Dim p As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set p=CallByName(o,"Parent",VbGet)
ParentType=TypeName(p)
Exit Function
Failed:
ParentType="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SeriesCount(c As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
SeriesCount=Scalar(c.SeriesCollection.Count)
Exit Function
Failed:
SeriesCount="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AxesCount(c As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
AxesCount=Scalar(c.Axes.Count)
Exit Function
Failed:
AxesCount="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function HasAxisRead(c As Object,k As Variant,g As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
HasAxisRead=Scalar(c.HasAxis(k,g))
Exit Function
Failed:
HasAxisRead="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function HasAxisPut(c As Object,k As Variant,g As Variant,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.HasAxis(k,g)=v
HasAxisPut="ok:" & HasAxisRead(c,k,g)
Exit Function
Failed:
HasAxisPut="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function TitleRead(a As Object) As String
Dim t As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set t=a.AxisTitle
TitleRead="Text=" & ReadP(t,"Text") & ";Caption=" & ReadP(t,"Caption") & ";parent=" & ParentType(t)
Exit Function
Failed:
TitleRead="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function AxisSnap(a As Object) As String
Dim k As Variant,s As String
s="parent=" & ParentType(a)
For Each k In Array("Type","AxisGroup","HasTitle","MinimumScaleIsAuto","MinimumScale","MaximumScaleIsAuto","MaximumScale","MajorUnitIsAuto","MajorUnit","ReversePlotOrder")
s=s & ";" & k & "=" & ReadP(a,CStr(k))
Next
AxisSnap=s & ";title=[" & TitleRead(a) & "]"
End Function
Function AxisRead(c As Object,k As Variant,g As Variant) As String
Dim a As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set a=c.Axes(k,g)
AxisRead=AxisSnap(a)
Exit Function
Failed:
AxisRead="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SeriesSnap(s As Object) As String
SeriesSnap="Name=" & ReadP(s,"Name") & ";Order=" & ReadP(s,"PlotOrder") & ";Formula=" & ReadP(s,"Formula") & ";Values=" & ReadP(s,"Values") & ";X=" & ReadP(s,"XValues") & ";parent=" & ParentType(s)
End Function
Function ChartSnap(c As Object) As String
Dim s As String,n As Long,p As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
s="type=" & ReadP(c,"ChartType") & ";series=" & SeriesCount(c) & ";axes=" & AxesCount(c)
s=s & ";hasCat=" & HasAxisRead(c,xlCategory,xlPrimary) & ";hasVal=" & HasAxisRead(c,xlValue,xlPrimary)
For n=1 To c.SeriesCollection.Count
If n>4 Then Exit For
Set p=c.SeriesCollection(n)
s=s & ";s" & n & "=[" & SeriesSnap(p) & "]"
Next
ChartSnap=s & ";cat=[" & AxisRead(c,xlCategory,xlPrimary) & "];val=[" & AxisRead(c,xlValue,xlPrimary) & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
ChartSnap=s & ";SNAP-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
On Error GoTo Failed
s="chartCount=" & Scalar(ActiveSheet.ChartObjects.Count)
For n=1 To ActiveSheet.ChartObjects.Count
If n>2 Then Exit For
s=s & vbLf & "chart" & n & "=[" & ChartSnap(ActiveSheet.ChartObjects(n).Chart) & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot=s & ";SNAPSHOT-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function MakeChart(kind As Long,populated As Boolean) As Object
Dim co As ChartObject,w As Worksheet
Set w=ActiveSheet
w.Name="Data"
w.Range("A1").Value="Period":w.Range("B1").Value="Alpha":w.Range("C1").Value="Beta":w.Range("D1").Value="Gamma"
w.Range("A2").Value="Q1":w.Range("A3").Value="Q2":w.Range("A4").Value="Q3"
w.Range("B2").Value=10:w.Range("B3").Value=20:w.Range("B4").Value=30
w.Range("C2").Value=6:w.Range("C3").Value=12:w.Range("C4").Value=18
w.Range("D2").Value=8:w.Range("D3").Value=16:w.Range("D4").Value=24
Set co=w.ChartObjects.Add(10,20,360,216)
co.Chart.ChartType=kind
If populated Then co.Chart.SetSourceData w.Range("A1:D4"),xlColumns
Set MakeChart=co.Chart
End Function
Function SourceAttempt(c As Object,source As Variant,plot As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.SetSourceData Source:=source,PlotBy:=plot
SourceAttempt="ok"
Exit Function
Failed:
SourceAttempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DirectText(t As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
DirectText=Scalar(t.Text)
Exit Function
Failed:
DirectText="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Inspect(a As Object) As String
Dim t As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set t=a.AxisTitle
Inspect="type=" & TypeName(t) & ";nothing=" & CStr(t Is Nothing) & ";direct=" & DirectText(t) & ";call=" & ReadP(t,"Text")
Exit Function
Failed:
Inspect="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim c As Object,a As Object,t As Object,s As String
Set c=MakeChart(xlColumnClustered,True):Set a=c.Axes(xlValue,xlPrimary)
s="absent=" & Inspect(a)
a.HasTitle=True:Set t=a.AxisTitle
t.Text="X":t.Delete
s=s & vbLf & "deleted=" & Inspect(a) & ";held=" & DirectText(t) & ";heldcall=" & ReadP(t,"Text")
Probe=s
End Function

Function Host() As String
Host=Application.Version & "|" & Application.Build & "|" & ActiveWorkbook.Name & "|" & ActiveSheet.Name
End Function
